timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Good evening my name is Wanda Aiman and I'm running to be the next Salt Lake County clerk.
I would be honored to be your clerk in Salt Lake County. The clerk oversees the elections.
I spent 30 years in Salt Lake County working for top companies in managing departments.
I have a degree in business economics from the U and up during the 2012 elections I toured
the country and I oversaw caucuses and polling locations and I saw a lot of good things out there
that we're not doing here and I saw a lot of bad things and we I came back and I did some research.
We have election experts in the state we have a Democrat up at the U and a Republican in the
Lieutenant Co up in his office and what I found is that we need new energy in the Salt Lake
County clerk's office. There's a lot of work that needs to be done after 24 years were reactive
than being proactive in elections. Elections are under a microscope right now in the country.
We need to be a leader of cost effective elections in this county. Voter turned out in the
primary was less than 10 percent. We need to get voters excited about voting and I think a
way that we can do that is to give voters information about the candidates in one place. I will put
on my website information about all the candidates, Republican, Democrat. I don't care. You'll have
early access to their information and the issues that are on the ticket right away so you won't
have to hunt it down yourself. We need to build on what the clerk, I will build on what the clerk
has done in 24 years. These are worker hands. Please put these hands to work for you in Salt Lake
County. Thank you for your vote and my election is on November 4th and I really would appreciate
your vote for Wanda Amon Salt Lake County clerk. Thank you.
